name: Website Ventures Customer Handoff Pack
purpose: Make client handoff explicit after launch so domain ownership, support expectations, revision state and future changes are not left ambiguous.
requiredHandoffTopics: Website Control Session status when sold
rules: Customer domain ownership should remain explicit and transferable.
Do not imply ongoing maintenance if it was not sold.
Do not promise future edits for free merely because the original site was delivered.
Client remains responsible for the truth of supplied business facts, reviews, certifications, guarantees and project evidence.
This operational handoff is not a substitute for legal terms or an invoice.
